plugins.name: Chimbrowser
plugins.summary: A lean, private browser: it blocks ads and trackers, makes YouTube smooth, and has an AI sidebar.
plugins.description: Chimbrowser is a dark, private web browser built on the browser engine Windows already has (Microsoft Edge WebView2). It blocks ads and trackers with Brave's filter engine and the EasyList, EasyPrivacy and uBlock Origin lists, strips tracking codes from links, and sends Global Privacy Control. YouTube plays smoothly: its ads are removed and skipped, and it picks a video format your graphics card plays easily. The AI sidebar (Ctrl+Shift+A) has Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and others, signed in with your own accounts, and can ask about the page you're on. Its settings are at chim://settings.
plugins.review: Read and built from its source for the Pyr Library. This build has four fixes from the review: websites can't read your clipboard without asking, Microsoft Defender SmartScreen keeps checking downloads and sites, pages can only open web pages in new tabs, and Chimbrowser's own pages can't be put inside other websites. It opens inside Pyr's window and fills its page there to the edges (Pop out gives it a window of its own), and carries its name, version and icon like other Windows programs. It needs Microsoft Edge WebView2, which Windows 10 and 11 already have.

plugins.name: Dice
plugins.summary: Roll dice in chat with /roll 2d6+1, or from its panel.
plugins.description: Type /roll and some dice (2d6+1, d20, 3d8-2 and so on; just /roll is a d20) and the roll goes to the channel as your message, with every die shown. Its panel has a button for each common die, a box for any other roll, and your last few rolls.
plugins.author: Firelit Games

plugins.name: Firelit Poker
plugins.summary: Deal Texas Hold'em showdowns in chat with /poker and /hand, and play heads-up Hold'em against a bot in its panel.
plugins.description: /poker deals a Texas Hold'em showdown and posts everyone's cards, the board and who wins: /poker on its own is you against the dealer, /poker Mara is you against Mara, and /poker Mara, Sam, Lee deals those players (up to 8). /hand deals you five cards and names your hand. Its panel is heads-up Hold'em against a bot: you both start with 1,000 chips and ante 10 a hand, your chips carry over from hand to hand until one of you runs out, and Share in chat posts how you're doing. The bot plays fair: it only sees its own cards and the board.
plugins.author: Maanix
plugins.review: Read and built from its source for the Pyr Library. An add-on: it runs in Pyr's sandbox, with no way to reach your files, the internet or anything else on your PC. It sends a message only when you use /poker or /hand, or click Share in chat, and names typed after /poker are sent as plain text. One change from the review: the bot's hidden cards say "face down" (the card-back character it showed them with isn't in Pyr's fonts).

plugins.name: Dominó Cubano
plugins.summary: Cuban double-nine dominoes against the computer: mano a mano (1 vs 1) or en pareja (2 vs 2 teams).
plugins.description: Cuban double-nine dominoes on a mahogany park table in old Havana. Mano a mano, you play Abuelo Cheo and draw from the pozo when you can't play; en pareja, you and Yoli take on Cheo and Pancho, fifteen tiles sleep face down and you pass when you can't play. Games run to 100, 150 or 200 points: going out scores every pip left in the other side's hands, a capicúa is worth 25 more, and a locked table (tranque) goes to the lightest hand. The pizarra keeps score, and every sound, the clack of the tiles, the knock for a pass and the optional son clave, is made in code.
plugins.author: Chimbita
plugins.review: Read and built from its source for the Pyr Library. A program: one window, with no internet, no files read and nothing saved between games. The one exception: if it ever crashes it writes a short report to domino-cubano-crash.txt in your temporary folder, so it can be fixed. It opens inside Pyr's window like Chimbrowser.
